p: The video starts with text asking if users still deploy to Vercel to show a doc. It then transitions to a split screen displaying an architectural doc alongside a terminal where a user highlights text to leave feedback, prompts Claude agent in CLI, and sees the doc title update in place. It ends with a CTA card highlighting artifactshare.com.
Artifact Share lets teammates review artifacts at a single URL and allows AI agents to automatically apply revisions to that same doc.

[{"timestamp":"00:00","observation":"Hook text appears: 'Still deploying to Vercel just to show a doc?'"},{"timestamp":"00:05","observation":"Document UI displays title selection and comment box creation."},{"timestamp":"00:14","observation":"CLI command executes Claude agent to consume feedback and update doc."},{"timestamp":"00:20","observation":"Document reflects updated title and resolved comment state."},{"timestamp":"00:27","observation":"Closing CTA title card shows domain and tagline."}]

The demonstration clearly communicates the human review and agent edit workflow across a shared artifact URL. Visual transitions are stable and terminal interactions are easy to follow. Adding ambient audio or subtle sound design would improve engagement.

p: ["no visible brand name, logo, or URL for the product itself","no explicit CTA or on-screen link at the end","opening frame is a dense wall of text, not a scroll-stopping hook","intended 'still deploying to Vercel' hook line is absent from the visible frames"]

The demo clearly executes the mechanic (comment on a doc, agent edits via CLI, republishes, same URL, comments panel shows resolution) and the closing caption states the message well. But nothing in these frames names or brands the product, so a scrolling viewer could easily mistake this for a generic 'AI agent edits docs' clip rather than Artifact Share specifically, and there's no link or CTA to act on. Visual execution is clean and legible with no artifacts, but the opening is a static text block rather than the sharper Vercel-workaround hook described in the creative brief.
